definition: the pull of one object on another
description: In a muddy scrapyard on a grey day, a huge round rusty electromagnet hangs from chains on a crane, with twisted bars and scraps of metal stuck to its underside. Two laughing workers in white hard hats and yellow high-visibility jackets, a young woman and a young man, hold on tight to flat metal sheets that the magnet pulls up towards itself, leaning back and struggling to keep them down. Piles of scrap metal lie against a concrete wall and a crane stands behind.

en.question: What is the huge magnet doing?

de.answer: Der Magnet zieht zwei Metallplatten an.
de.question: Was macht der riesige Magnet?

es.answer: El imán está atrayendo dos chapas de metal.
